title: Governing Issue Contract
purpose: Defines the canonical repository-generic governing issue structure and its subordinate presentation adapters.

issue_fields.label: Change type
issue_fields.description: Use one canonical bounded change classification. Product-artifact implementation is reserved for ordinary changes that create or modify maintained product artifacts. Atomic authority transition is reserved for a narrowly governed inseparable specification/plan/artifact transition.

issue_fields.label: Problem statement
issue_fields.description: What problem or gap does this issue address?
issue_fields.placeholder: Explain the need in repository terms.

issue_fields.label: Intended outcome
issue_fields.description: What outcome should be true when the work is complete?

issue_fields.label: Governing specifications
issue_fields.description: List the authoritative specifications and relevant records.
issue_fields.placeholder: repo.manifest, repo.development-workflow, and any other governing specs.

issue_fields.label: Implementation-plan workstreams/stages
issue_fields.description: For Product-artifact implementation, list one or more stable workstream/stage IDs from the cited accepted implementation plan, one per line.

issue_fields.label: Atomic transition evidence
issue_fields.description: Required only for Atomic authority transition. State the accepted invariant that makes the change inseparable, why no valid intermediate accepted revision exists, and how affected implementation-plan sections will be revised or explicitly reaffirmed before maintained implementation is treated as authorized in the exact proposed revision.
issue_fields.placeholder:
Invariant: ...
No valid intermediate revision: ...
Plan impact: revise/reaffirm ...

issue_fields.label: Accepted default-branch base
issue_fields.description: Actual repository default branch name and exact accepted revision.

issue_fields.label: In-scope behavior and paths
issue_fields.description: What behavior and repository paths are explicitly in scope?
issue_fields.placeholder: List files, directories, and behavior to change.

issue_fields.label: Explicit exclusions
issue_fields.description: What is explicitly out of scope?
issue_fields.placeholder: List excluded behaviors, files, or follow-up work.

issue_fields.label: Dependencies and predecessor evidence
issue_fields.description: What must exist first, and what evidence supports this work?
issue_fields.placeholder: Prior issues, commits, specs, validation evidence, or other predecessors.

issue_fields.label: Ordered patch plan
issue_fields.description: State the implementation steps in order.

issue_fields.label: Validation plan
issue_fields.description: How will the change be validated?
issue_fields.placeholder: scripts/validate for repository-wide validation; add focused leaf checks and evidence capture as needed.

issue_fields.label: Acceptance criteria
issue_fields.description: What must be true for this issue to be accepted?

issue_fields.label: Completion gate
issue_fields.description: What must be satisfied before this issue can close?

issue_fields.label: Open decisions or authority conflicts
issue_fields.description: Record any unresolved authority questions or conflicts.

issue_fields.label: Successor work explicitly not authorized
issue_fields.description: What follow-on work does this issue not authorize?
issue_fields.placeholder: List unrelated or deferred successor work.

issue_fields.label: Optional context
issue_fields.description: Optional notes that help with session recovery or review.
issue_fields.placeholder: Related links, assumptions, risks, or recovery notes.

normative_requirements.text: The repository shall define exactly one canonical governing-issue contract for bounded governed work.

The canonical governing-issue field collection in this specification is normative structured contract data under repo.authority-model. Requiredness, validation kind, and field meaning shall be taken directly from those field definitions.
Empty placeholders shall not satisfy required governing-issue fields.
Material scope changes shall be recorded in the governing issue before they are treated as authorized scope.
A governing issue shall not be closed until its completion gate is satisfied.
Completion of a governing issue shall not authorize unrelated successor work.

The canonical Change type field shall use a constrained repository-owned classification. Product-artifact implementation is the exact classification for ordinary governing issues that create or modify maintained product artifacts and shall activate the stricter product-artifact evidence gate. Atomic authority transition is the exact classification only when an accepted-state invariant makes a normative specification revision, required plan-impact handling, and maintained-artifact synchronization inseparable across accepted default-branch revisions. Descriptive prose shall not activate either gate.

A governing issue declared as Product-artifact implementation shall identify one or more stable workstream or stage identifiers from its cited accepted implementation plan; those selected identifiers define the bounded plan scope whose controlling accepted product specifications are enforced by issue-body field policy.

When Change type is Atomic authority transition, the governing issue shall contain the Atomic-transition evidence fields defined by this specification. Lifecycle eligibility and sequencing are owned by repo.development-workflow.
